sell.title: Sell on Tallaby | Start Your Online Store
sell.description: Learn how to sell on Tallaby.com — free registration, vendor dashboard, product listing guide, and Egypt-wide shipping.
sell.heroDescription: Join Egypt's growing marketplace. Reach shoppers nationwide, manage your store from one dashboard, and grow your brand with tools built for local sellers.
sell.introductionDescription: Tallaby connects Egyptian shoppers with trusted local sellers. As a vendor, you get your own storefront, tools to manage products and orders, and access to customers across the country.
sell.introductionFeature1Description: Create a branded seller profile with logo, description, and a catalog customers can browse.
sell.introductionFeature2Description: Sell to customers across Egypt through Tallaby's marketplace and discovery features.
sell.introductionFeature3Description: Secure checkout, order tracking, and customer reviews help buyers shop with confidence.
sell.beforeYouStartDescription: Registration is free with no monthly subscription. Complete your store profile to begin listing products.
sell.requirementsDescription: Have these ready when you create your seller account.
sell.requirement1: A valid email address and mobile number
sell.requirement2: National Egyptian ID for identity verification
sell.requirement3: A bank account to receive your sales payouts
sell.requirement5: Business address and support contact details
sell.pricingDescription: No hidden fees — you only pay when you sell.
sell.pricingPlanDescription: Start selling with zero upfront cost.
sell.pricingFeature3: Customer shipping calculated automatically by governorate
sell.faq1Answer: Most sellers complete onboarding in under 10 minutes. Once your store profile is submitted, you can access the vendor dashboard and start adding products.
sell.faq2Answer: Payouts are processed according to Tallaby's seller payment schedule. You'll receive funds from completed orders to your registered bank account.
sell.faq3Answer: Yes. Tallaby uses a self-ship model — you pack and ship orders to customers. The platform calculates shipping costs for buyers based on governorate and product weight.
sell.dashboardTitle: Get to know your seller dashboard
sell.dashboardDescription: After registration, manage your entire business from dashboard.tallaby.com — your control center for products, orders, and store settings.
sell.dashboardFeature1Description: Add, edit, and organize your catalog with images, pricing, inventory, and rich product descriptions.
sell.dashboardFeature2Description: View incoming orders, update statuses, and keep customers informed through each step.
sell.dashboardFeature3Description: Track performance and manage your seller profile, support contacts, and business details.
sell.listingTitle: How to list your first product
sell.listingDescription: Create compelling listings that help customers find and trust your products.
sell.listingStep1: Sign in to the vendor dashboard and open Products → Add product.
sell.listingStep2: Write a clear title and add high-quality images (plain background recommended).
sell.listingStep3: Add a detailed description with key features, specs, and benefits.
sell.listingStep4: Set your price, stock quantity, category, and weight for shipping calculations.
sell.listingStep5: Optionally enable free delivery on individual products to attract more buyers.
sell.productPageDescription: When customers view your product, they see a unified page designed to answer questions and drive purchases.
sell.productPart1Description: Clear, descriptive product name that helps shoppers understand what you're selling.
sell.productPart2Description: Multiple high-quality photos showing your product from different angles.
sell.productPart3Description: Selling price, any discounts, and shipping cost shown upfront.
sell.productPart4Description: Your store name and rating so buyers know who they're purchasing from.
sell.productPart5Description: Rich content with features, specifications, and usage details.
sell.productPart6Description: Customer feedback that builds trust and helps future buyers decide.
sell.fulfillmentDescription: Tallaby uses a self-ship model. You store, pack, and ship — we help buyers see accurate delivery costs upfront.
sell.fulfillmentFeature1Description: Customer shipping fees are calculated automatically based on delivery governorate and cart weight.
sell.fulfillmentFeature2Description: Offer free shipping on selected products to stand out in search and product listings.
sell.fulfillmentFeature3Description: Pack orders your way and ship using your preferred courier while updating order status in the dashboard.
sell.afterSaleDescription: Great sellers focus on fulfillment speed and customer satisfaction.
sell.afterSaleOrdersDescription: Process new orders quickly, update shipment status, and respond to customer inquiries through your support channels.
sell.afterSaleReviewsDescription: Positive store ratings appear on your product pages and help new customers trust your brand.
sell.growthDescription: Once your store is live, use these levers to increase visibility and sales.
sell.growthFeature1Description: Run discounts and promotional offers to attract new buyers and reward returning customers.
sell.growthFeature2Description: More quality listings mean more ways for customers to discover your store.
sell.growthFeature3Description: Share your referral code from your profile to grow your network and unlock platform rewards.
sell.checklistDescription: Follow these steps to build momentum as a new Tallaby seller.
sell.checklistItem1: Complete your store profile and upload your logo
sell.checklistItem2: Add your first product with clear photos and description
sell.checklistItem3: Set accurate stock levels and product weight for shipping
sell.checklistItem4: Fulfill your first order on time and update its status
sell.checklistItem5: Encourage satisfied customers to leave store reviews
sell.checklistItem6: List more products and test promotions to find what converts
sell.finalCtaDescription: Put your products in front of shoppers across Egypt. Registration is free — create your store and list your first product in minutes.

about.title: About Tallaby | Your Everything Store in Egypt
about.description: Tallaby is an Egypt-first online marketplace connecting shoppers with independent sellers across categories — accessories, beauty, fashion, home and more.
about.heroDescription: Tallaby brings together independent sellers from across Egypt so you can discover and buy the products you need, all in one place.
about.whatIsBody: Tallaby is a multi-vendor marketplace built for Egyptian shoppers. Instead of one store, you get many — browsing products from different sellers side by side, with one cart, one checkout, and cash on delivery available on eligible orders.
about.howItWorksBody: Browse categories or search for what you need, compare products from different sellers, and check out with cash on delivery, wallet, InstaPay or card. Track your order from your account and request a return if something isn't right.
about.value1Description: A wide range of categories from accessories and gadgets to beauty, fashion and home products, all searchable in one place.
about.value2Description: Clear pricing, seller information, and customer reviews help you shop with confidence.
about.value3Description: Shipping across Egyptian governorates, with cash on delivery available so you can pay when your order arrives.
about.ctaDescription: Explore our categories or start selling your own products on Tallaby.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions | Tallaby
faq.description: Answers to common questions about ordering, delivery, returns, payment and selling on Tallaby.
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Find quick answers about shopping, delivery, returns and more.

items.question: What is Tallaby?
items.answer: Tallaby is an Egypt-first online marketplace where you can shop products from many independent sellers in one place — accessories, beauty, fashion, home essentials and more.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Add products to your cart, go to checkout, choose a delivery address and payment method, then confirm your order.

items.question: Can I pay cash on delivery?
items.answer: Yes. Cash on delivery is available on eligible orders, alongside mobile wallet, InstaPay and card payment.

items.question: Where does Tallaby deliver?
items.answer: Tallaby delivers across Egyptian governorates. Delivery cost is calculated based on your governorate and the weight of your order.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: Sign in and go to My Orders to see your order status, or use the order confirmation link sent after checkout.

items.question: How do I return a product?
items.answer: From My Orders, open the order and start a return within 30 days of delivery. You'll get a return (RMA) number to track it.

items.question: How do refunds work?
items.answer: Once your returned item is received and inspected, your refund is processed to your original payment method where possible.

items.question: How do I contact Tallaby?
items.answer: Email us at tallabycommerce@gmail.com or message us on WhatsApp — see our Contact page for details.

items.question: Can I shop from multiple sellers in one order?
items.answer: Yes, your cart can include products from different sellers, and they're grouped by seller at checkout.

items.question: How do I become a seller on Tallaby?
items.answer: Visit our Sell on Tallaby page to learn about requirements, pricing and how to register your store.

items.question: How do I use a coupon code?
items.answer: Enter your coupon code at checkout before placing your order. Eligible discounts are applied automatically once validated.

items.question: What payment methods are available?
items.answer: Cash on delivery, mobile wallet, InstaPay, and card payment via Paymob.

items.question: Is online card payment available?
items.answer: Yes, you can pay securely by card at checkout using Paymob.

items.question: How do I change my language?
items.answer: Use the language switcher in the header to switch between Arabic and English at any time.

items.question: Do I need an account to order?
items.answer: No — you can check out as a guest. Creating an account lets you save addresses, track orders and view your order history across devices.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions | Tallaby
terms.description: The terms and conditions for using the Tallaby marketplace as a shopper or seller.
terms.heading: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of Tallaby and the purchase of products from sellers on our marketplace. By using Tallaby, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: 1. Using Tallaby
sections.body: You may browse and shop on Tallaby as a guest or with an account. You agree to provide accurate information and to use the marketplace only for lawful purposes.

sections.title: 2. Accounts
sections.body: When you create an account, you're responsible for keeping your login details secure and for activity on your account. Notify us if you suspect unauthorized use.

sections.title: 3. The Marketplace Model
sections.body: Tallaby is a marketplace: products are listed and sold by independent sellers, not by Tallaby itself. Each seller is responsible for the accuracy of their listings, the quality of their products, and fulfilling orders.

sections.title: 4. Orders & Pricing
sections.body: Prices are shown in Egyptian pounds (EGP) and are set by sellers. Placing an order is an offer to purchase, which is confirmed once accepted. Product availability and pricing may change before an order is confirmed.

sections.title: 5. Payment
sections.body: Tallaby supports cash on delivery, mobile wallet, InstaPay and card payment via Paymob. Card payments are processed securely by Paymob; Tallaby does not store your card details.

sections.title: 6. Shipping & Delivery
sections.body: Delivery is available across Egyptian governorates. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your governorate and order weight. See our Shipping page for details.

sections.title: 7. Returns & Refunds
sections.body: Eligible items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. See our Returns & Refunds page for the full process.

sections.title: 8. Prohibited Use
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the marketplace, including submitting false information, attempting to bypass security, or using Tallaby for any unlawful purpose.

sections.title: 9. Intellectual Property
sections.body: Tallaby's branding, design and platform content belong to Tallaby. Product content (images, descriptions) belongs to the respective sellers or their licensors.

sections.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Tallaby facilitates transactions between shoppers and sellers but is not the manufacturer or seller of record for marketplace products. To the extent permitted by law, Tallaby is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the marketplace.

sections.title: 11. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of Tallaby after changes are posted means you accept the updated terms.

sections.title: 12. Governing Law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.

returns.windowBody: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, in the condition you received them.
returns.howToBody: Sign in to your account, go to My Orders, open the order and select the item you want to return. You'll get a return (RMA) number to track your request.

shipping.description: Tallaby delivers across Egyptian governorates. Learn how shipping costs are calculated and how to track your order.
shipping.heading: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.intro: Tallaby delivers to customers across Egypt. Here's what to expect.
shipping.coverageBody: Tallaby delivers to governorates across Egypt. Available delivery areas are shown at checkout based on your address.
shipping.costBody: Shipping costs are calculated automatically at checkout, based on your delivery governorate and the weight of the products in your order.
shipping.freeDeliveryBody: Some products are offered with free delivery by their seller — look for the free delivery badge on the product page.
shipping.trackingBody: Once your order is placed, you can follow its status from My Orders in your account.
shipping.codNote: Paying cash on delivery? You'll pay the courier when your order arrives.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Tallaby
privacy.description: How Tallaby collects, uses and protects your information when you shop or sell on our marketplace.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information Tallaby collects and how we use it when you use our marketplace.
privacy.dataIntro: Depending on how you use Tallaby, we may collect:
privacy.data1: Account details: name, email address and phone number
privacy.data5: Reviews, ratings and questions you submit
privacy.data6: Seller application details, if you apply to sell on Tallaby
privacy.data7: Support messages sent through our contact form, email or WhatsApp
privacy.useBody: We use your information to process orders, provide customer support, manage your account, and communicate with you about your orders and, if you opt in, marketing updates.
privacy.paymentBody: Card payments are processed securely by Paymob. Tallaby does not store your card number or payment card details.
privacy.cookiesBody: Tallaby uses a session cookie to keep you signed in and to remember your cart. See our Cookie Policy for details.
privacy.sharingBody: When you place an order, the seller receives the order and delivery details needed to fulfill it.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy | Tallaby
cookies.description: How Tallaby uses cookies to keep you signed in and remember your cart.
cookies.heading: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Cookies are small files stored on your device that help websites work. Here's how Tallaby uses them.
cookies.whatBody: Tallaby uses cookies to keep you signed in, remember your language preference, and maintain your shopping cart between visits.
cookies.controlBody: You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Note that blocking essential cookies may prevent you from staying signed in or using your cart.

payment.title: Payment Methods | Tallaby
payment.description: Pay with cash on delivery, mobile wallet, InstaPay or card on Tallaby.
payment.heading: Payment Methods
payment.intro: Choose the payment method that works best for you at checkout.
payment.codBody: Pay in cash when your order is delivered to your door. Not available for orders with high shipping costs.
payment.walletBody: Pay using your mobile wallet at checkout.
payment.instapayBody: Pay instantly using InstaPay at checkout.
payment.cardBody: Pay securely by credit or debit card using Paymob. Your card details are handled directly by Paymob — Tallaby does not store them.
